title: test: ensure YAML config takes precedence over initialize config in mermaidAPI
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary
Added unit tests in `mermaidAPI.spec.ts` to verify config precedence behavior.
The tests confirm that when both an initialize config and a YAML config are provided, the YAML config is applied with higher priority
